Hey Jurij, this one looks like a tough one to me, but i see a couple
of things would make me hesitant to go long. First there was no HH
engulf on the major swing. Next your entry signal looks to be part of a
 larger PAZ that didn't get engulfed (these I always find tough to
draw). Finally right around where you entered you have the engulf down
(which could have been a fakeout) and no engulf breaking up at the end
of that compression.

author: Jurij
text:
There is only one playing field, the one made up by ITs.

What I mean, there's no range/trend or other "choppy" market conditions, only the right scale.

When the market trends (nothing to the left) then ITs are driving price
on the HTF playing field, likeweise range/chop creates the LTF field.
